id: title:Gilbert09:hide raw connection errors from session sign in

review.posthog_relevance: Reduces information disclosure risk in credential validation error messages for the Metabase warehouse connector.
review.reason: The change adds exception handling and test assertions to prevent raw exception details (potentially containing sensitive host/IP or credential information) from being exposed in error messages when connecting to Metabase. This is a localized, bounded improvement to the warehouse connector's reliability and security posture.
review.uncertainty: The actual production benefit depends on whether the connector is actively used and whether the specific exception types could carry sensitive metadata; this review relies solely on the supplied hunk and its associated comments, not on external adoption or incident data.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are cited. No score assigned.

observations.posthog_connection: Checks if the underlying cause of a Metabase connection error is a requests.RequestException, returning a generic connection error message instead of the raw exception. This could prevent sensitive host/IP details from being exposed in credential validation error messages.

observations.behavior: Adds pytest parameterization and asserts that connection error messages do not leak raw exception details.
